summary: Independent review found that the base retains both invalid-launch paths and that the exact candidate adds all four required guards in the actual migrated launcher source: a positive/<=1024 thread check in both launchers, a zero-token no-op in both, and a zero-topk no-op in the masked launcher. Validation and parameter construction remain before the no-op returns. Source regressions fail before and pass after. CUDA runtime execution remains unverified because the assigned ROCm gfx950 toolchain cannot compile the CUDA-specific header.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on the exact recorded base: both launcher contract tests failed because the common block-limit guard was absent (2 failed).
Candidate regression at exact commit 3f713629: both source-contract tests passed (2 passed).

tests.what_was_measured: Four direct base cases allocated tensors on gfx950 and entered the actual SGLang native JIT build. All stopped before launch because hipcc could not find cuda_fp8.h.
Direct candidate cases reached the native build and hit the same unchanged cuda_fp8.h architecture prerequisite before the candidate launcher could execute.

gpu_execution_evidence: PyTorch detected exactly one AMD Instinct MI350X with gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. Reproduction tensors were allocated on that device and hipcc was invoked with --offload-arch=gfx950, but the reviewed kernels did not execute because compilation failed first.
remaining_limitations: No CUDA GPU or CUDA toolkit was assigned, so the original cudaErrorInvalidConfiguration and the candidate's CUDA no-op/RuntimeCheck behavior were not observed at runtime.
The real candidate JIT native library could not be rebuilt on ROCm because the CUDA-specific source unconditionally includes cuda_fp8.h, which is absent from ROCm 7.2.
No DeepSeek weights or multi-rank deployment were available; the DP-attention idle-rank serving path was not reproduced.
Non-empty GPU numerical equivalence was not measured because compilation failed before kernel execution.
The included regression and independent checks establish the source launch contract, not compiled CUDA execution.
